About

About me.

I’m a full-stack Lua/U developer with over five years of experience, working on both popular Roblox games and smaller projects. I use Fusion, Rojo and Knit, as well as Roact, React-Lua and Roblox-TS. I’ve built tower defense systems, combat mechanics, inventory systems and more, plus the animation and modeling that goes with them.

I also have 7+ years across Python, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, CoffeeScript, TypeScript, C++, HTML, C#, Shell Script and Rust. In Minecraft modding I’ve used Fabric, Forge and Spigot, and worked with bytecode directly through Mixins, ASM and JIT. I’ve contributed to big Minecraft clients including Feather Client and Delta Client.

Networking with Netty, Kryo and Protobuf. Tooling in Groovy and Kotlin DSL, Maven and Webpack. Injection through Guice and Dagger. Reactive patterns with RxJava, Project Reactor and coroutines. Front and back stacks across React, Angular, Express.js, Spring Boot, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets and gRPC.
